description: Segregation of Duties (SoD) rules. Each rule lists two role definitions that must never be held by the same employee at the same time, whether within a single system or across two different systems. 'system' values must match the review's system identifiers: core_banking, loan_system, database.

rules.description: An employee who can create a loan should not also be able to approve it.
An employee who approves a loan should not also be able to disburse funds for it.
An employee who opens accounts should not also be able to approve transactions on them.
An employee who develops database changes should not also administer the database.
